question: Where is the office of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• United Nations Environment Programme office in India is located in **New Delhi.**

 
• United Nations Environment Programme is an agency of United Nations that sets the global environmental agenda and promotes the implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system.
 
• It is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.__
 
• It was founded by Maurice Strong, the first director of UNEP, as a result of the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in June 1972.
